checks.message: The unified wrapper retains an unchanged v1 core and bounded supplemental evidence.
The named rule revision explicitly distinguishes legacy records from bounded module observations and exact contextual task bindings.
The supported current-delivery envelope has a bounded structure.
The file-map SHA-256 matches the exported files; this is not a trusted signature.
The supplied original requirement spans resolve within the exported source.
Saved findings/excerpts match deterministic source replay with the named verifier rules. Rendering and human checks are not replayed.
Included AI citations resolve to source and risk annotations reference their recorded delivery/report/risk; model judgment, human identity and provider execution are not proven.
Included client-report fields and derived outcomes are consistent with the locked plan; browser observations themselves are not independently proven.
Included HTTP reports bind to the supplied delivery, file digest, plan and frozen target. No HTTP execution or present approval is proven.
Acceptance references resolve to their original retained snapshots, including historical reports; this does not prove identity, consent authenticity or payment.
Repair/retest tasks are replayed from bounded append-only buyer/seller events; older delivery files are outside this package.
Supplemental objects pass their native validators and exact public payload hashes; participant identifiers are withheld.
Current-delivery source spans and deployment byte plans resolve against the exported files. Older task reports receive native-record checks; their earlier source files are not included or replayed.
The current supplemental catalog is re-derived from the included exact records and its frozen artifact context.
Each retained buyer decision resolves to its exact frozen report versions and snapshot, including exclusions and acknowledged findings.
Every task source/retest finding resolves to its exact report, and current/frozen task heads replay from their original event versions. Older delivery files are not included.
